missing: Measured results on sub-$400 boxes: how many simultaneous 4K HEVC HDR-to-SDR tone-mapped Jellyfin transcodes the DXP2800, F2-425/F4-425 Plus and DS225+ actually sustain, whether each vendor OS exposes /dev/dri to Docker Jellyfin out of the box, and current diskless prices with codes so the shopper knows which picks really land under $400.
why: No major reviewer tests this; the only authority (jellyfin.org) explains encoder quality but names no NAS. Everything else is niche spec-comparison guides that admit they use datasheets, affiliate roundups, two recycled-domain listicles with unverifiable testing claims, and pages answering neighbouring questions (homelab, 2-bay backups, mini PCs). None applies the $400 constraint with current prices or checkable transcode numbers. A focused page with sub-$400 picks, verified Quick Sync/Docker passthrough status, tested codes and a direct pick would stand out, just like the solar kit win.
